children: 1stDibs posted an investor presentation detailing its 2026 product roadmap focused on AI search, personalization, service and shipping improvements.
Posted investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) on Sept 2, 2026; furnished under Item 7.01 for Regulation FD disclosure.
Discovery pillar: launching AI search, semantic/NLP search, and image search to improve search success and buyer conversion.
Personalization: deployed foundational user profile model and personalized collections to tailor recommendations across touchpoints.
Service: launched AI customer service agent and new BPO partner; chat resolution rose from 14% to 25% since June.
Shipping: expanded prequote freight coverage to ~90%, cut parcel rates (USPS 30–50% off), and targets >85% on-time shipping and >95% tracking coverage.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: 1stDibs posts September 2026 investor presentation outlining AI search, personalization, service and shipping roadmap
